# semaphore_ex_project_workflow_approval (Action)

Submits one bounded workflow approval decision explicitly. The server evaluates the immutable approval snapshot and current eligibility; this action does not read or bypass approval policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The server authorizes this decision against the immutable approval snapshot.
action "semaphore_ex_project_workflow_approval" "approve_release" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    workflow_id = 4
    run_id      = 88
    node_id     = 19
    status      = "approved"
    comment     = "Reviewed in change window."
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_workflow_approval.approve_release
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node_id` (Number) Approval node to decide.
- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the target.
- `run_id` (Number) Workflow run owning the approval.
- `status` (String) Decision status.
- `workflow_id` (Number) Workflow owning the approval.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional approval comment.
